protocol.population: First 20 showcase repositories; latest merged PRs in first 500 closed pulls returned at collection time, then descending merged_at and PR number.
protocol.amendment: Before any retrieval scoring, the 100-closed-PR pilot yielded 29/30 cases (no SQLAlchemy eligible PR); expanded uniformly to 500 closed PRs for all 20 repositories.
protocol.allocation: One eligible PR per repository plus a second for the first ten manifest repositories; no replacements after scoring.
protocol.eligibility: At least two modified/renamed existing production source files in the scanned base graph, excluding pure barrels and index.ts. Added/deleted/out-of-root/non-source/default-excluded files cannot be held out or seeded; all changes and exclusions retained. The recorded base must be an ancestor of the PR merge commit; other API bases are rejected to prevent future-graph leakage.
protocol.heldout: Sorted eligible paths indexed by int(sha256(repository + "/" + PR number),16) modulo count.
protocol.task: PR title only; no body, head graph, diff contents or held-out path supplied to either ranker.
protocol.baseline: Seeds first, then case-insensitive title keyword matches in paths or file contents, then files in seed folders; keyword hit count descending, folder distance ascending, path ascending. Greedy ceil((UTF8 path bytes + UTF8 reason bytes + body bytes +160)/4), same task overhead and constraints first. No graph expansion.
protocol.metric: One held-out observation per PR: path appears in emitted entries within budget; signatures count as retrieval, not full-body reading.
